title: Overwriting collateral breaks collateral gains logic
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  In the `StabilityPool` contract, when 180 days have passed since the sunset of a collateral, enabling a new collateral overwrites the previous one.  In this process, the `epochToScaleToSums` mapping is cleared, but not the `collateralGainsByDepositor` and `depositSums` mappings. This means that the pending gains for the old collateral will be counted as gains for the new collateral.
